title: GrantSystem
description: GrantSystem is a plugin for Minecraft 1.16.5 (Purpur) that allows you to give donation groups to players using commands
body:
**GrantSystem is a plugin for Minecraft servers that provides a convenient and flexible system for issuing donation groups to players through teams, with the ability to limit the number of disbursements and fully customize to meet the needs of your project.**

**What does GrantSystem add?**

Donation team: Allows certain players to give donation groups to other players using the /grant <nickname> <donation> command.
Payout limits: For each donation group, you can configure how many times and to whom you are allowed to give certain donations. This prevents abuse and gives you full control over the distribution system.
Flexible configuration via config: All limits, output commands, and even the message language are configured in the config. You can add any new donations and commands to issue them without changing the code.
Multilingual: All messages are stored in separate language files. Russian and English languages are supported, you can add your own.
Reset limits: The /grantreset <nickname|all> command allows the administrator to reset the limits for a specific player or for all at once, even if the players are offline.
Compatibility with LuckPerms: Donation is implemented through executing commands from the config, which allows you to integrate the plugin with LuckPerms or any other rights system.
Flexible rights system: All commands are protected by permissions that can be configured through any rights manager.

**Why choose GrantSystem?**

Security and control: You determine for yourself who can give donations and how many times, which excludes abuse.
Easy integration: It does not require complicated configuration — everything is managed through YAML files.
Offline Player Support: All functions work even for players who are offline.
Modularity: You can easily expand the list of donations and commands without restarting the server.
Pleasant user experience: Beautiful messages and sounds make the donation process noticeable and festive for all players.

**Who is this plugin for?
**
For servers with a donation system, where it is important to control the granting of privileges.
For projects where donations need to be delegated to trusted persons, but with restrictions.
For administrators who value flexibility, security, and ease of configuration.

**_GrantSystem is your universal tool for an honest and beautiful donation on the Minecraft server!_**
